blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–For nearly a century, the Rizal Memorial Football Stadium has stood at the heart of Philippine sport, its Art Deco façade bearing witness to the triumphs, heartbreaks, and aspirations of generations of Filipino athletes. Opened in 1934 and built as the centerpiece of the Rizal Memorial Sports Complex, the stadium is more than concrete, steel, and turf. READ: Infantino lauds facelift that will turn Rizal into ‘true jewel’ It is a living monument to Philippine football history, a venue where the nation’s sporting identity has unfolded before packed grandstands and international audiences.
